key_findings: miR-223 directly targets the NLRP3 3'UTR and its overexpression lowers NLRP3, ASC, caspase-1, IL-1beta and IL-18 in CCI mouse spinal cord.
miR-223 overexpression shifts macrophages from M1 to M2 and reduces CCI-induced pain behaviors.
